# Performance model (generated by scripts/perf_model.py)

Measured inputs: dynamic instructions per class (Spike), D-cache misses (16 KB 4-way 64 B PLRU).  **Every cycle value below is a model with stated assumptions, not a measurement** (see the docstring of scripts/perf_model.py).

## 2. ISA + microarchitecture (cycle model, default assumptions)

qmac8 = 1 cycle, qreq = 2, taken-branch penalty 2, load-use 1 (half of the loads), miss = LAT + 8 with LAT = 10.

| Config | model cycles (G) | CPI | speedup vs B1 | ISA-only speedup | cycle/ISA |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| B0 | 18.140 | 1.399 | 0.55x | 0.58x | 0.94 |
| B1 | 9.899 | 1.313 | 1.00x | 1.00x | 1.00 |
| X0 | 2.252 | 1.747 | 4.40x | 5.85x | 0.75 |
| X1 | 2.096 | 1.793 | 4.72x | 6.45x | 0.73 |
| X1T | 1.789 | 1.543 | 5.53x | 6.50x | 0.85 |
| X2 | 1.747 | 2.115 | 5.67x | 9.13x | 0.62 |
| X2T | 1.447 | 1.767 | 6.84x | 9.21x | 0.74 |

cycle/ISA < 1: the pipeline and memory system eat part of the instruction-count gain (branch penalty, load-use, qmac8/qreq latency, cache misses).

## 3. Sensitivity of B1 -> X2T to the unknown latencies

| qmac8 latency | qreq latency | LAT 10 + misses | LAT 40 + misses | no misses |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 2 | 6.84x | 5.98x | 7.59x |
| 1 | 4 | 6.82x | 5.96x | 7.56x |
| 2 | 2 | 5.91x | 5.31x | 6.41x |
| 2 | 4 | 5.90x | 5.30x | 6.39x |
| 3 | 2 | 5.21x | 4.77x | 5.55x |
| 3 | 4 | 5.19x | 4.76x | 5.54x |
| 4 | 2 | 4.65x | 4.33x | 4.90x |
| 4 | 4 | 4.64x | 4.33x | 4.88x |

The qmac8 row is the quantity the RTL milestone has to measure.  The model charges the latency per instruction (it assumes the two independent accumulators of the inner loop hide nothing); a pipelined qmac8 with dependent-accumulate forwarding would cost 1 cycle per instruction regardless of its depth.
